correctness.rationale: The literal frozen Puiseux-pair assertion is false with the standard convention when n−m=1: X/Y has order one at both preimages, so these branches are smooth and have no Puiseux pairs. The repair corrects both finding and slogan. Reconstructed the homogeneous map: its degree is 2n, there are no basepoints, and distinct affine preimages occur only at the two finite coincidence types. A same-power/inverse-product collision of type A is determined by an m-th root ξ and 2n choices of u; type B uses an n-th root η and 2m choices; dividing by two gives n(m−1)+m(n−1). Coprimality excludes triple fibers within a type, and transcendence excludes a mixed fiber or simultaneous derivative vanishing. The collision tangents differ by a single component sign after scaling by the parameter, and both components are nonzero. At infinity the coordinate orders are (a,n), a=n−m. When a>1, making the first coordinate an exact a-th power yields first characteristic exponent n, with gcd(a,n)=1, and when a=1 the local delta is zero. The two leading binomials have distinct coefficients 2^a c^{−m} and 2^a c^m, so substituting a parametrization into the other branch equation gives order an, also for smooth branches. The total delta equals the plane arithmetic genus. The polynomial tangent triple has degree 2(m+n) and no finite or infinity basepoint; characteristic-zero biduality gives map degree one on its image. Differentiation gives cP=c²F+G; F and G have no common zero, so a transcendental c² is a regular value of the nonconstant rational function −G/F and the polynomial has full degree and simple nonzero roots. The repaired proof supplies explicit nonvanishing at node parameters: for X=u^{2m}, Y=c²u^{2n}, cP=(n−m)XY−(m+n)Y+(m+n)X−(n−m); one of X,Y is a root of unity according to collision type and the other is transcendental, with nonzero coefficient. Affine zeros are therefore all ordinary flexes at distinct smooth image points. At infinity the vanishing sequence (0,a,n) gives weight 2n−m−3 per branch, and the total is 6n−6. All arguments hold for the stated transcendental phase, not all algebraic phases. Replay is direct via the given formulas and the two collision substitutions; the frozen finite symbolic checks at c=2 are only corroboration and were not relied on for the general proof.

value.rationale: The affine node count alone leaves the projective boundary and tangent geometry unresolved. The exact local intersection, dual degree, and completed flex divisor provide natural invariants over the whole coprime family and distinguish it from the unshifted genus-zero specialization. The result does not purport to classify all dual singularities, bitangencies, real flexes, or exceptional phases.
